The remaining embedding-related settings (e.g. `feed_polling_enabled`, `feed_polling_url`, `embed_by_username`, `embed_truncate`, `embed_post_limit`, selectors) still exist under the `embedding:` group in `config/site_settings.yml` with no new description or cross-reference indicating that host management moved to the new Customize screen. That’s a concrete UX/documentation gap introduced by this change, not a functional defect.
